title: Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning
Same goal. A different grasp.
同一个目标，不同的抓取方式
task: Place the soup can in the basket
description: The teacher provides the task structure: acquire the can, carry it, and release it in the basket. TGL approaches and grasps the can differently while preserving the intended outcome.
教师演示提供抓取、搬运和放入篮子的任务结构。TGL 采用不同的接近与抓取方式，完成相同的目标。
watch: Compare the approach direction and gripper orientation before the lift.
观察抬起罐子前，两侧的接近方向和夹爪朝向。

title: A new contact point. The same subgoal.
换一个接触位置，完成同一子目标
task: Place the bowl on the plate
description: TGL grasps a different part of the bowl rim from the teacher. The reusable subgoal stays the same, while the physical grasp is grounded in the current scene.
TGL 抓取碗沿的位置与教师不同。可复用的子目标保持不变，实际抓取根据当前场景确定。
watch: Follow where the fingers contact the rim in each rollout.
对照两段视频中夹爪与碗沿的接触位置。

title: Miss. Observe. Try again.
抓取未成功，观察后再次尝试
task: Move the bowl from the cabinet to the plate
将柜子上的碗移到盘子上
description: The first grasp does not secure the bowl. In the supplied system rollout, TGL makes another attempt and completes the placement. This example illustrates feedback-driven recovery during execution.
第一次抓取未能夹稳碗。在这段系统视频中，TGL 再次尝试并完成放置，展示执行过程中的反馈纠错。
watch: Watch the first lift attempt, then the renewed approach and successful transfer.
留意第一次抬起尝试，以及随后重新接近、抓取和搬运的过程。

title: From a taught sequence to execution.
从演示中的步骤到自主执行
task: Place the dressing bottle in the basket
description: The teacher and TGL both complete the bottle transfer. The pair shows the acquire, transport, and release stages on another object.
教师与 TGL 都完成瓶子的搬运。这组对照展示抓取、运输与释放的步骤如何应用于另一种物体。
watch: Track the bottle from the initial grasp to release above the basket.
观察从初始抓取到篮子上方释放的完整过程。

title: Turn a goal into a physical change.
将任务目标变成可观察的物理变化
description: This task requires an interaction with the stove knob rather than moving an object to a new location. Both clips show the robot approaching and turning the control.
这项任务需要操作炉灶旋钮，而非搬运物体。两段视频展示机器人接近并旋转旋钮的过程。
watch: Focus on the gripper–knob contact and the resulting rotation.
观察夹爪与旋钮的接触，以及旋钮随后的转动。
